;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Second Libyan Civil War]], [[Battle of Tripoli (2018)]]
**The death toll from recent clashes in [[Tripoli, Libya|Tripoli]] rises to 96. The clashes, which began on August 26, 2018, have also left 444 wounded and 16 missing. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/middle_east/libya-says-death-toll-from-tripoli-clashes-climbs-to-96/2018/09/21/946ac076-bd77-11e8-8243-f3ae9c99658a_story.html (''The Washington Post'')] 
*[[Islamist insurgency in Mozambique]]
**Twelve villagers are killed and 14 are wounded in an attack by [[Ansar al-Sunna (Mozambique)|Ansar al-Sunna]] on a [[village]] in northern [[Mozambique]]. [https://www.news24.com/Africa/News/12-killed-14-wounded-in-mozambique-jihadist-attacks-source-20180921 (News24)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Dunrobin tornado]]
**A [[tornado]] hits near [[Dunrobin, Ontario]] then goes through [[Ottawa]], [[Canada]]. 25 people are injured and many houses are destroyed. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2018/09/21/tornado-touches-down-in-ottawa-and-gatineau-que.html (The Canadian Press via ''Toronto Star'')]

;Health and environment
*The government of [[Nigeria]] announces that 61 people have died and 50 others have been hospitalized from a [[cholera]] outbreak in [[Yobe]]. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2018-09/21/c_137484434.htm (Xinhua)]

;Law and crime
*A woman goes on a stabbing rampage in [[Queens]], [[New York City]], injuring five, including three infants. All are in stable condition. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/09/21/us/new-york-day-care-stabbing/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Vietnam]]
**[[President of Vietnam|Vietnamese President]] [[Trần Đại Quang]] dies at the age of 61 following an extended illness. [[Vice President of Vietnam|Vice President]] [[Đặng Thị Ngọc Thịnh]] succeeds as the acting President. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-45597822 (BBC)]
*[[Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping]]
**The director of the [[National Energy Administration]] of China, [[Nur Bekri]], is placed under investigation for [[Graft (politics)|graft]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-china-corruption/china-places-top-energy-official-a-senior-uighur-under-investigation-idUSKCN1M104H (Reuters)]

;Science and technology
*[[Trans Mountain Pipeline]]
**[[Minister of Natural Resources (Canada)|Canada Natural Resources Minister]] [[Amarjeet Sohi]] orders the [[National Energy Board]] to conduct a new review of the [[Trans Mountain Pipeline#Expansion project|Trans Mountain Pipeline]] expansion project. [https://edmontonsun.com/commodities/energy/feds-launching-review-of-oil-tanker-traffic-in-bid-to-renew-pipeline-approval/wcm/1b2b2960-296d-4369-8a7a-54eed375dad3 (The Canadian Press via ''Edmonton Sun'')] [https://ca.reuters.com/article/domesticNews/idCAKCN1M11QI-OCADN (Reuters Canada)] 

;Video games
*[[Telltale Games]]
**[[Video games|Video game]] [[Video game developer|developer]] [[Telltale Games]] announces [[Telltale Games#Majority studio closure and aftermath (2018)|the closure of most of its studio]] via public statement. 225 employees are laid off, leaving only 25 left in order to fulfill obligations. [https://www.gameinformer.com/2018/09/21/narrative-adventure-studio-telltale-games-essentially-closes-down (Game Informer)]
